en: The postcard shows a color photograph of a large, modernist concrete hotel building with terraced balconies and prominent white diagonal supports along the front. Several 1970s–1980s style cars are parked in front on a curved access road, with two pedestrians walking on the pavement. The back of the postcard is printed with Hungarian text identifying the location and hotel, a pre-printed 2 Ft Magyar Posta stamp, address lines, and publisher/photographer information.
